description.value: Shi-Art Chinese Cuisine is a full-service Chinese restaurant nestled inside Richmond Centre, specializing in dim sum, fresh seafood, and traditional dishes with a modern touch. The restaurant is known for standout offerings like crab, golden shrimp, Chiu Chou dumplings, and crispy spring rolls, drawing both locals and visitors. The shopping mall location means ample parking and an accessible, central Richmond setting for anyone passing through.
